author: Yffe
content: Found during #20's multi-agent concurrency testing (it caused the ENOSPC the #18 critic hit). check::run_verus/invoke_verus runs verus with .current_dir(std::env::temp_dir()); verus leaves a ~4.3M compiled-binary sibling (forge_<stem>_check_<pid>_<n>, no extension) in the shared temp dir. run_verus removes only the .rs SOURCE temp, not verus's compiled-binary OUTPUT. On a clean exit ~no leak, but a verus run that ERRORS mid-compile orphans the binary -> unbounded disk growth under sustained multi-agent fresh-verification. Fix: run verus in a per-run scratch SUBDIR that is removed wholesale (or clean the compiled-binary sibling alongside the .rs). check.rs concern; surfaced by #20, out of #20's cache-guarantee remit.
